blind.B1: No. Aged rat TTX common-peroneal-nerve block disuse model (S2.8.p1, S2.9.p1); groups sham, TTX, recovery after TTX exhaustion, repeated TTX, right-limb control. No exercise arm; no exercise words in metadata.
blind.B2: Left limb (TTX / recovery / repeated TTX; n=3 each) vs pooled right contralateral limbs; sham (n=3) excluded because no DEGs sham vs control (S2.14.p1). Paper: Atrophy vs Control 2106, Recovery vs Control 2008, Repeated Atrophy vs Control 3937, Repeated vs Recovery 3198 (S3.5.p1).
blind.B3: Yes: each animal contributes left and right limb (354_L/354_R, ...); key = numeric prefix of title, candidate-key table shows none linked, but the title prefix pairs all 12 animals. Paper cites paired treated-vs-contralateral comparisons only as validation (S2.8.p1).
blind.B4: Paper says only DESeq2 within Partek, left-limb conditions relativized to pooled right limbs (S2.14.p1); pairing and joint-versus-pairwise not stated.
blind.B5: 'Genes with a >= 20% FC and FDR <= 5% were considered DEGs' (S2.14.p1); counts as in B2.
